product.description: The FlexiFit Pro 30kg Resistance Band Set offers a versatile training solution for athletes and beginners alike. Each band measures 120 cm in length and is engineered with a blend of natural rubber and latex to provide consistent tension across a 30 kg resistance range. The set includes four bands in neon green, a sturdy carrying pouch, and a quick‑reference guide for workout routines. Designed for both home and outdoor use, the bands are lightweight, durable, and easy to clean, making them ideal for strength training, rehabilitation, and mobility work.
